title: Christmas Carol Singing
description: Get in the mood for Christmas at the American Library! Together we’ll sing Christmas Carols accompanied by our piano man Michael R. and our violist Michael F., hear Christmas stories and poems, do a little quiz, munch Christmas cookies and drink some Glühwein or Punch. For big and small people and everybody in between. Admission free, donations and cookies cheerfully accepted! Please call ahead and reserve a place – sign-up starts beginning of November!
